categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and changes wallet transaction creation code in `src/wallet/spend.cpp` and `src/wallet/feebumper.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unnatural transaction fingerprint where anti-fee-sniping backdating causes fee-bumped transactions to have an older locktime than the original. The wallet category prioritizes transaction creation privacy and anti-fingerprinting, but the issue occurs in fewer than 2% of replacements according to author analysis, making it a worthwhile improvement that is reasonably deferrable.
